name: BCW London Territorial Championship
epitaph: The fed's own Title History page and News page together trace three changes of this belt across roughly three months in 1999: Brent Morris won it in a Battle Royale, John Cole beat Morris, Scott Simpson beat Cole (in Canada), and R.J. Draper beat Simpson on 11 July 1999 — the last champion this holding attests. No earlier or later history survives.

name: BCW National Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own Title History page attests exactly one reign: Angels of the Night won this belt from Bobby Blaze and The Phantom at London Live, Buckingham Palace. No individual member of Angels of the Night is named anywhere in the held record, and no later change survives.

name: BCW National Championship
notes: The fed's own 4 April 1999 card bills the newly-crowned champion as "the NEW NeWA European / BCW National Champion" in one breath — the same belt carrying a hub-level name alongside its own promotion name, per the fed's own text, not a separate title and not evidence of any join to another wing.
epitaph: The fed's own 4 April 1999 card and Title History page together trace a long, mostly undated chain: Titan won it in a Four Man Battle Royale at Manchester Colosseum, then Chris Mann, The Wraith, HICAL (twice, the title held up between), and Titan (a second time) each held it in turn, none of it dated. Rowdy Piper then beat Titan in an I Quit Match at Gaslaw Gala, 16 May 1999 — the fed's own broadcast of that night receipts the change directly. Lord Ravager beat Rowdy Piper the following day, 17 May 1999, per the fed's own Title History page alone — the last champion this holding attests.

name: BCW JuniorWeight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own Gaslaw Gala broadcast (16 May 1999) and Title History page together attest exactly one reign: Hypnosis won this belt with a Stunner. The two documents disagree on the defeated opponent — the broadcast itself stages the match against The Phantom, while the Title History page names The Purple Haze — both readings stand, neither reconciled. No later change survives.
